notes: B-62 (2026-10-29), the M21 twin of obliterating_bolt_planeswalker.json: Scorching Dragonfire 'deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.' Basri Ket (printed loyalty 3) loses all 3 loyalty, and the zero-loyalty state-based action is a death (CR 700.4, 704.5i), so the replacement exiles it. Before the fix it went to the graveyard.
